felarboc: 🏳️ Flags on public buildings are flown at half-mast.
ma_nincs: There is no holiday or memorial day today.
lablec: Daily notice: Settings → Community → Holiday channel • /unnepek
ujev_szoveg: The first day of the new year — happy New Year to everyone!
nemetek_nev: Day of Remembrance of the Deported and Expelled Germans of Hungary
nemetek_szoveg: On 19 January 1946 the first deportation train left Budaörs. We remember the Germans of Hungary who were driven from their homes.
kultura_szoveg: Ferenc Kölcsey finished the manuscript of the Hungarian national anthem on 22 January 1823. We celebrate Hungarian literature, music and art!
diktaturak_nev: Memorial Day for the Victims of the Communist Dictatorships
diktaturak_szoveg: On 25 February 1947 Soviet military authorities abducted Béla Kovács, secretary-general of the Independent Smallholders' Party. We remember the victims of the communist dictatorships.
nonap_szoveg: We celebrate women: mothers, grandmothers, wives, daughters, friends and colleagues!
marcius15_nev: National Day — the Revolution and War of Independence of 1848–49
marcius15_szoveg: On 15 March 1848 revolution broke out in Pest: the Twelve Points and the National Song became symbols of freedom and equality. Wear a cockade!
kolteszet_szoveg: On Attila József's birthday we celebrate Hungarian poetry. Read a poem today — or write one!
holokauszt_nev: Memorial Day for the Hungarian Victims of the Holocaust
holokauszt_szoveg: On 16 April 1944 the confinement of the Jewish population in ghettos began in Subcarpathia. We remember the Hungarian victims of the Holocaust.
nagypentek_szoveg: The day commemorating the crucifixion of Jesus — one of the quietest, most solemn days of the Christian year.
husvet_szoveg: The feast of the Resurrection. Happy Easter!
husvethetfo_szoveg: The day of the traditional Hungarian sprinkling custom — happy Easter!
majus1_szoveg: The first of May: a celebration of workers, with fairs and a day of rest.
anyak_szoveg: On the first Sunday of May we celebrate mothers and grandmothers. Thank you for everything!
honvedelmi_szoveg: On 21 May 1849 the Hungarian army recaptured the Castle of Buda. We honour the defenders of the homeland.
hosok_szoveg: On the last Sunday of May we remember all those who gave their lives for their country.
punkosd_szoveg: The feast of the coming of the Holy Spirit, fifty days after Easter.
punkosdhetfo_szoveg: The second day of Pentecost — a time for traditional Whitsun customs.
osszetartozas_szoveg: The Treaty of Trianon was signed on 4 June 1920. We remember, and affirm that Hungarians across borders are one nation.
pedagogus_szoveg: On the first Sunday of June we celebrate teachers and educators. Thank you for your work!
szabadsag_szoveg: In June 1991 the last Soviet soldier left Hungary — after 46 years the country was free again.
augusztus20_nev: National Day — Foundation of the State and St Stephen's Day
augusztus20_szoveg: We commemorate the founding of the Hungarian state by King St Stephen and break the bread of the new harvest. Fireworks tonight!
nepmese_nev: Day of the Hungarian Folk Tale
nepmese_szoveg: On the birthday of the great storyteller Elek Benedek we celebrate Hungarian folk tales. "Once upon a time…"
aradi_nev: National Day of Mourning — the Martyrs of Arad
aradi_szoveg: On 6 October 1849 the thirteen generals of the War of Independence were executed in Arad, and Prime Minister Lajos Batthyány in Pest.
oktober23_nev: National Day — the Revolution and Freedom Fight of 1956
oktober23_szoveg: On 23 October 1956 the Hungarian people rose up against dictatorship and Soviet occupation. The Republic of Hungary was also proclaimed on this day in 1989.
mindenszentek_szoveg: The feast of all saints. We light candles in memory of our loved ones.
halottak_szoveg: We remember our departed loved ones, bringing flowers and lighting candles at their graves.
tudomany_szoveg: On 3 November 1825 István Széchenyi offered a year's income from his estates to found the Hungarian Academy of Sciences.
november4_nev: National Day of Mourning — the crushing of the 1956 Revolution
november4_szoveg: On 4 November 1956 Soviet troops attacked Budapest and crushed the revolution. We remember the heroes and the victims.
nyelv_szoveg: On 13 November 1844 Hungarian became the country's official language. We celebrate our mother tongue!
mikulas_szoveg: Santa (Mikulás) arrives today — hopefully everyone finds chocolate in their boots, not a switch! 🎅
szenteste_szoveg: The eve of Christmas: a decorated tree, presents and time together. Peaceful, blessed holidays!
karacsony_szoveg: The celebration of the birth of Jesus. Merry Christmas! 🎄
karacsony2_szoveg: The second day of Christmas — rest, family visits and festive pastries.
szilveszter_szoveg: The last day of the year. Let's see the old year out in style — at midnight comes the anthem and a toast! 🥂
